statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of prior cerebrovascular events
The denial reason is coordination of benefits (CO-22)
Continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring is indicated to characterize the arrhythmia burden and guide long-term anticoagulation and rate control strategies
